extraction.Name: Nancy Lambert (formerly Nancy Prue), testifying about Oliver Prue, Dec'd
extraction.Gender: Male (Oliver Prue, deceased); Female (deponent Nancy Lambert)
extraction.NOTES: Allottee is Oliver Prue, deceased; deponent is his former wife Nancy Lambert, formerly Nancy Prue, age 38. Oliver Prue left five children at time of death, one of whom has since died (four surviving). There was some commission or obligation of nearly $500 paid at time of sale. Nancy Lambert states she did not sign the papers at the time he sold the land, and states: 'if for this or any other reason there is any way to get anything out of the land on account of the forced patent I should like to have it.' She did not live on the land as a home. Subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on May 7, 1929.
